# Sol Implementation File Plan

The Awtsmoos renews each frame, yet every vessel keeps its name;
Awtsmoos.com shall share one movie language without flattening every flame.

## Collision-safe implementation boundary

Observed dirty/concurrently-owned surfaces are excluded from this pass: existing Animator and Mitzvah Studio production files, including the active Animator mobile CSS and film/export work. Existing clean Video Editor, Nesher Studio, Rebbe, and `apps/shared` files will only be changed after their recorded hashes are rechecked immediately before each rewrite.

## New shared movie files

- `apps/shared/movie/package.json` — local ESM boundary and focused verification script.
- `apps/shared/movie/schema/MovieDefaults.js` — canonical defaults and supported vocabulary.
- `apps/shared/movie/schema/MovieNormalizer.js` — serializable canonicalization and cumulative scene timing.
- `apps/shared/movie/schema/MovieValidator.js` — structured, AI-repairable validation errors.
- `apps/shared/movie/timeline/MovieEasing.js` — named easing vocabulary.
- `apps/shared/movie/timeline/KeyframeInterpolator.js` — deterministic property interpolation.
- `apps/shared/movie/timeline/MovieTimeline.js` — active scene/node evaluation.
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieToolContract.js` — declarative AI authoring contract.
- `apps/shared/movie/renderers/CanvasNodePainter.js` — shapes, text, people, charts, paths, pseudo-3D fallback.
- `apps/shared/movie/renderers/CanvasParticlePainter.js` — deterministic particle systems.
- `apps/shared/movie/renderers/CanvasMovieRenderer.js` — responsive canvas renderer.
- `apps/shared/movie/runtime/MoviePlayer.js` — play, pause, restart, seek and current-scene state.
- `apps/shared/movie/index.js` — stable public surface.

## Three-minute proof

- `apps/shared/movie/showcase/scenes/SceneFactory.js` — compact scene/node factories.
- `apps/shared/movie/showcase/scenes/ActOne.js` through `ActFour.js` — twelve fifteen-second scenes.
- `apps/shared/movie/showcase/AwtsmoosThreeMinuteMovie.js` — exactly 180 seconds.
- `apps/shared/movie/showcase/index.html`, `main.js`, `showcase.css` — mobile-first runnable showcase.
- `apps/shared/movie/tests/threeMinuteMovieSmoke.js` — exact duration and feature-coverage verification.

## Adapter pass after shared proof

New bridge modules will translate the canonical document into each app's native project/state rather than replace native renderers. Entry-point rewrites are authorized only for files that still match the recorded prewrite hash and remain clean. Animator/Mitzvah integration must be additive in new adapter files until the concurrent owners settle.

## Completion evidence

The pass is not complete until the shared smoke test passes, the showcase runs in desktop and mobile browser viewports, console errors are reviewed, clean app bridges are exercised, an actual encoded 180-second artifact is produced through an existing renderer/export path when available, touched files are reread, and planned-versus-actual delta is closed.
